t: Peel and stick circuit stickers for building lit paper circuits and crafts.
steps: Find the Chibitronics education page and read the project templates.
Choose a kit and check the price with the seller.
Buy the stickers, copper tape, and a coin cell or battery pack.
Check that batteries are included. Resellers say they may not be.
Try one paper circuit yourself before class.
Ask IT or a site lead for help storing the kits.
Run a first project with a few students.
